quote: Unable to imagine a sustainable and easy to maintain new design for my garden, I found Margerida from Balga Designs. Once we sorted out plants I did and didn't like, and talked about her design ideas, I felt confident to step back and watch my new garden emerge. It's early days, but I love her choice of mostly native plants and small grasses blended with some of my established plants (which have now had a proper prune). Autumn is a great time for growth, especially now TC Alfred has left!
author: Beth Taylor
